hints.title: Try every starting cell
hints.body: The first letter of the word can start anywhere on the board.

hints.title: Backtracking
hints.body: Match one letter, mark the cell used, and explore its four neighbors.

hints.title: Undo the choice
hints.body: Restore the cell after exploring so other paths can use it.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
for each starting cell:
    if search(row, column, 0): return true
return false

search(r, c, index):
    if index == len(word): return true
    if out of bounds or board[r][c] != word[index]: return false
    save = board[r][c]
    board[r][c] = '#'
    found = any search(neighbor, index + 1)
    board[r][c] = save
    return found
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
